product_metadata.title: Door Draft Stopper Door Sweep Weather Stripping Silicone Draft Blocker Against Drafts, Dust, Noise.
features: 【KEEP COLD IN SUMMER AND WARM IN WINTER】: This door draft stopper effectively keep cold air out in winter and prevent hot air in during summer. It can maintained at a comfortable level, help save electricity costs and reduce expenses.
【DUSTPROOF】: Keeping your room quietly and clean.
【SAY GOODBYE TO NOISE】: Effectively reduce annoying sound up to five times. Keep your room quietly.

【STRONG STICKINESS】: This draft blocker is made of high quality silicone, which can firmly adhere to the wood, plastic, metal, and glass like the back door, front door, bedroom door, interior door and so on.
